serves: TICKET BP20 - the ability-set assets are empty, and that is why the verbs are dead
doctrine: This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the four DA_AbilitySet_* assets. Content/Abilities is
its projection. Regenerate the projection; never let the projection drift ahead of this file.
Every row's input_tag is the whole mechanism, not a label. UBRAbilitySet::GiveToAbilitySystem
stamps it onto the spec's dynamic source tags and UBRAbilitySystemComponent::AbilityInputTagPressed
matches against exactly that. A row with an ability and no tag is granted and permanently
InputTag.Jump is ABSENT on purpose. ABRPlayerState::GiveNativeAbility grants UBRGA_Jump from
C++; a row here would give it a second spec. abilityset_plan.py refuses the profile if it

note: BP20 B3. ABRGameMode's constructor sets all four class defaults in C++; GM_BR's saved
values still win. Verified 1 Aug 2026 by reading the import table: PlayerControllerClass
held BP_ShooterPlayerController, the template's controller, so ABRPlayerController's input
never ran. CLEARING is the fix, not repointing - that is why the C++ defaults were added.
BP20 B4 and B5 are CONFIRMATIONS, not edits. The generator reads them and reports; it
never writes to PC_BR or BP_BRcharacter, because a write is exactly the failure mode
B4 warns about (a value serialised on the Blueprint beats Config/DefaultGame.ini forever).
